title: The Border of the DMZ
author: Sebastian Almeida
blurb: Orsen Hartwell, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
